data.narrative:
Breaker Industries is a Seed-stage company in Defense & Security that has raised $6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage, using the $6M raised as a proxy base, yielding $15M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector peers at Seed or Series A stage—UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—producing a median valuation of $400M and a range of $125M to $1.0B.

These methods produce a wide triangulated range: low of $13M, median of $208M, and high of $460M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median reflects the heterogeneity in Defense & Security valuations at early stages, particularly the outsized positioning of UFORCE. Key uncertainties include whether Breaker's technology and market traction more closely resemble earlier-stage benchmarks or the upper tier of the peer set, and whether the peer sample adequately reflects the company's specific competitive position. A valuation in the $20M–$50M range may be more defensible pending granular due diligence on product differentiation and customer pipeline.
